name: typst-invoicer
description: Monthly contractor invoices: TypeScript computes the amount, Typst renders the PDF, Gmail delivers it.

scripts.smoke: rm -rf build/smoke && mkdir -p build/smoke && cp -R examples/data build/smoke/data && tsx src/cli.ts --data-dir build/smoke/data --out-dir build/smoke/invoices --date 2026-11-27
